exclusion_reason: Sustained recompiled instruction throughput over the frozen workload is measured on this host, but the 770-MIPS floor is defined against the BPTK-002 reference desktop, which is not the measurement host, so the floor cannot be certified and the benchmark stays red.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when the frozen workload sustains >= 770 MIPS on the pinned BPTK-002 reference desktop.
expected_failing_assertion: The measurement host is not the pinned reference desktop, so the measured MIPS cannot certify the 770-MIPS floor even when the recompiler clearly beats the interpreter wall.
active_gate_evidence: test/performance.test.mjs measures sustained recompiled throughput over the frozen mixed workload via lib/performance.mjs benchmarkRecompiler and pins the declared 770-MIPS floor, that the recompiled path is equivalent to the interpreter with zero fallback, that is_floor_cleared_here is reported as a boolean measured on this host, and that measured_on_reference_desktop is false so the floor is never claimed certified off the reference machine.
procedure: Run the frozen CPU-bound workload through the recompiler.
Measure sustained instruction throughput on the reference desktop.
pass_criterion: The workload mix is the frozen one.
